## Mapping Decisions

- The source already arrives in Senzing JSON; the mapping routes values verbatim (verbatim check passes).
- RECORD_TYPE comes from each record's own FEATURES.RECORD_TYPE (type discriminator): NAME_ORG on ORGANIZATION records (aliases carry NAME_TYPE AKA), NAME_FULL or NAME_FIRST/NAME_LAST on PERSON records.
- INCORPORATED (root year, ORGANIZATION records only) is mapped to the REGISTRATION_DATE feature, which the mapping reference defines as the organization's incorporation date; the value is moved into FEATURES unchanged. The shared SenzingJsonPassThrough gained a root-to-feature option for this; the four earlier outputs regenerate byte-identical.
- Disclosed relationships (domain REFERENCE: 4 anchors, 14 pointers with roles Owns N%, President, Principal, Global Parent) are kept verbatim. Anchor key 2011 sits on record 2012; owners 2013 and 2014 point to 2011.
- Identifiers: TAX_ID (EIN, VAT, GSTIN with country), NATIONAL_ID (Singapore UEN), LEI_NUMBER (2 organizations).
- REGISTRY_ROLE and REGISTRY_STATUS are payload.
